head.name: @fzlt/core/board-page
head.lead: The host page as the board. Its text glyphs become terrain and food, its buttons become targets. Geometry is measured only in the read phase, on a budget (Range reads capped per refresh; 12.5 Hz while the page moves, 2 Hz once it is still), kept in typed arrays and indexed with a collide Grid, so near / hit in a step never read layout or allocate. consume writes a literal 0/1 into the page's own Text node through the ledger (no wrappers, no clones); from a step it is queued and written in render. Recall gives every glyph back, and a newer edit by the host page wins. Coordinates are viewport CSS px (getBoundingClientRect). Glyph indices hold for a frame: a rescan (read phase, after the page changed) renumbers them. Targets only (text: false) with still: Infinity: a scene that reads page elements (headings, buttons) re-measures only when the page moves or changes, so its still frames read nothing.

sizesNote: Measured on this build: minified and gzipped with everything it imports, the way npm run size checks the budget in CI.
